prompt: Follow this grid, stored as one block of six boxes, row by row.

trace.label: Counting boxes in the single block from 0, `g[1][2]` is box number
How many boxes does `g` have in total

explain: Line 2 copies g[0][2] (3) into g[1][0]. Line 3 adds g[1][2] (6) and g[1][1] (5) to get 11. The box number of g[r][c] is r * 3 + c, so g[1][2] is box 5. Two rows of three make six boxes.
